lines.en: Hi, Oscar. Did you talk to the teacher about the test?
lines.pt: Oi, Oscar. Você falou com a professora sobre a prova?

lines.en: Yes. She said the test was easy, but I’m not sure.
lines.pt: Sim. Ela disse que a prova era fácil, mas não tenho certeza.

lines.en: She told me that it was only twenty questions.
lines.pt: Ela me disse que eram só vinte perguntas.

lines.en: She said we could use a dictionary, too.
lines.pt: Ela disse que podíamos usar um dicionário também.

lines.en: Really? Last time she said we had to close all books.
lines.pt: Sério? Da última vez ela disse que tínhamos de fechar todos os livros.

lines.en: Maybe the rules changed. She said the exam was on Thursday morning.

lines.en: Then I must study tonight. I told my brother I would call him later.

lines.en: Good idea. A classmate told me that the first part was about reading.
lines.pt: Boa ideia. Uma colega me disse que a primeira parte era de leitura.

lines.en: Did she say we had to write an essay?
lines.pt: Ela disse que tínhamos de escrever uma redação?

lines.en: Yes. She said it was short, only one page, and that we had two hours.
lines.pt: Sim. Ela disse que era curta, só uma página, e que tínhamos duas horas.

lines.en: Great. She said the test was easy, so let’s study together in the library.
lines.pt: Ótimo. Ela disse que a prova era fácil, então vamos estudar juntos na biblioteca.

compare.ask: She told me that it was easy.
compare.br: No Brasil, dizemos “ela disse que a prova é fácil” e depois “ela disse que a prova era fácil”.
compare.tip: Diga: “She told me that it was easy.”
compare.us: Em inglês, o verbo volta um passo: She said the test was easy. Use said sem pessoa e told com pessoa: She told me that it was easy.

solo: Peça uma experiência pessoal do aluno com essa diferença.
group: Leia as duas colunas e peça que apontem a maior diferença.
Pergunta: She told me that it was easy.
extra90: Dupla: um fala como no Brasil, o outro como nos EUA.

facts.big: She said the test was easy
facts.label: Relato com said e told
facts.sub: Use said + frase ou told + pessoa + frase. O verbo volta um passo no tempo: is vira was, can vira could, will vira would.

facts.label: disse que…
facts.sub: Use said sem pessoa: She said the test was easy. O verbo da frase volta um passo: is vira was, can vira could, will vira would. A palavra that é opcional na fala do dia a dia.

facts.label: me disse que…
facts.sub: Use told com uma pessoa depois: She told me that it was short. Ele told Ana he was late. Não diga said me. A estrutura é told + pessoa + (that) + frase no passado.

We say She said me that. → Falso (We say She told me that.)

pages.title: A classroom in Chicago · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a windy afternoon in Chicago. Ana and Gil are in the same class. The teacher said something about the test. Ana told Gil the news in the hall. Gil said he was a little worried. Now they check what she really said.
“Hi, Ana. Did you talk to the teacher about the test?” says Gil. “Yes. She said the test was easy, but I’m not sure.” says Ana. “She told me that it was only twenty questions.” says Gil.
